appse ai - v0.0.2

Release Date: December, 2025

This major release for appse ai is marked by the introduction of tiered subscriptions, offering access to premium features and advanced functionalities across the platform. This new model is built alongside powerful additions to workflow design, including the essential new HTTP Node for external API integration, and powerful conditional logic using the Filter Node and Decision Nodes. We have also significantly expanded our ecosystem, rolling out full integration support for 15+ new apps.

Platform usability and stability are dramatically improved with key enhancements: better setup control via Prefix/Suffix options in Credential Management, streamlined building with Action Search, and enhanced reliability in complex processes through improved Execution Ordering. Coupled with an updated Workflow Designer and over 100 individual fixes, this release ensures a more powerful, reliable, and user-friendly automation experience.

New Features

  • New Built-in Nodes:

    • HTTP Node: Make HTTP requests to any external API or service with various authentication methods
    • Filter Node: Filter data based on configured rules to conditionally process workflow data
    • Decision Nodes: Create conditional logic branches to route data based on evaluation criteria

  • Subscription: Introduced tiered subscriptions to offer users access to premium features and functionalities across the platform.

    • Smoother Upgrades: One-click upgrade process for features and plans
    • Secure Payments: Accept credit cards and manage subscriptions

  • Credential Management: Prefix and Suffix options for relavant credential properties

  • Execution Ordering: Workflow execution ordering introduced for branched and multiple workflow scenarios

  • Action Search: Introduced search functionality in Action List Dropdown

Improvements

  • App Trigger Selection: Refined to display only apps with available trigger actions
  • Workflow Usability: Enabled double-click to open configuration for all nodes
  • New User Onboarding: Streamlined credential setup flow respecting initial app selections
  • Configuration UI: Corrected Expression Box display for array-type fields.
  • Node Configuration: General UI enhancements for better user experience
  • Consistent Experience: Standardized action names across all apps
  • Dynamic Options: Added dynamic options to the configuration screens
  • Execution History: Fixed pagination display when per page value exceeds records
  • Workflow Output: Removed extra 'default' wrapper from copied JSON output
  • Credential Configuration Flows: Updated for OpenAI and Salesforce to align with latest API requirements, including stricter validation rules

Bug Fixes

  • Portal Navigation: Corrected menu item tags and redirection links
  • User Login Flow: Fixed bug preventing logout and re-login during onboarding
  • Logout Display: Eliminated error page display on successful logout
  • Trigger Node Error: Resolved "Application Error" when adding node after Trigger Node
  • Output Display: Fixed display issues with Output JSON after Node Post Configuration.
  • Data Flow Display: Ensured previous node's output reliably displayed in next node's input
  • App Icon Display: Corrected App Trigger Node icon on Workflow Listing page
  • Dark Mode Visibility: Fixed Close button visibility on Credential Popup in Dark Mode
  • Blank Data Return: App Trigger Node no longer returns blank data without new records
  • Skipped Node Data: Fixed residual output data retention in skipped nodes
  • Execution Button State: Disabled execute buttons in read-only Execution History
  • Infinite Progress State: Fixed node execution remaining in "In progress" state indefinitely
  • App Trigger Text: Minor UI corrections to App Trigger action text display
  • Multiple Triggers: Users can now add multiple App Trigger Nodes in single workflow
  • Webhook Output: Fixed no output display after switching to Production Webhook URL
  • Webhook Overwrite: Prevented output overwrite when test URL invoked without listener
  • Logo Distortion: Fixed appse ai logo distortion in Forgot Password email template
  • Tooltip Positioning: Adjusted to prevent obstruction of textboxes
  • Node Sequence: Corrected execution sequence in parallel branches
  • Notes Panel: Temporarily removed the non-functional 'Notes' button in workflow designer
  • Filter Node: Now executes correctly according to configured filtering rules
  • HTTP Credentials: Fixed validation and naming issues for various authentication types
  • Broken Links: Fixed multiple 'View Docs Link' 404 errors across various apps and nodes
